description: This is a Java source file defining the PersonService class, which handles business logic for managing person entities, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting person records through a repository.

classes.name: PersonService
classes.description: Service class providing CRUD operations for Person entities, leveraging a repository and mappers, with transaction management and exception handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new person record from a create request, handles data integrity violations (e.g., duplicate email) and returns response DTO.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a person by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all persons with pagination support.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing person record identified by ID using provided update data, with exception handling for data integrity issues.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a person record by ID, throws exception if the record does not exist.
